evidence_items.locator: Section 'OpenAI: trust never built, and distrust is compounding'

receipt.public_excerpt: OpenAI has built up a userbase of millions of Australians without first building a comparable level of trust.

evidence_items.explanation: The report provides evidence of weak trust on its Australian brand measure. Its open-ended, unprompted survey and twelve-month average through June do not establish how many people trusted OpenAI at the post date.

receipt.public_excerpt: OpenAI’s range overlaps with that low tier for most of the year before pulling clear of it in August.

evidence_items.explanation: Caliber reports an August recovery in its combined Trust & Like Score, which cautions against assuming a continuing collapse. The composite score is not a percentage of people trusting OpenAI, and the monthly period extends beyond the post.

unresolved_gaps: No located evidence directly measures the share trusting OpenAI in a population matching the broad claim at the post date.
The available measures are not interchangeable: unprompted brand mentions and a combined trust-and-liking score answer different questions.
No located evidence establishes the commercial implications of the claimed degree of distrust for OpenAI at that time.
